findings.description: delete_entry calls _require_reader, so any user the entry is shared with can permanently delete the owner's journal entry. All other mutating handlers (edit, share, unshare) use _require_owner. A shared reader can destroy data they should only be able to view, and the owner loses the entry.
findings.suggestion: Use _require_owner(entry, user) in delete_entry; readers should use leave_entry instead.
findings.title: delete_entry authorizes with reader check instead of owner check
